audit.evidence: This is an utility library that incrementally backup SQLite3 Database. This approach was proposed by a StackOverflow User which I turned into code. Currently the library may be used in two languages NodeJs and Python (C support is *Coming soon*). ／ SQLite3 is one of the most popular relational databases (and built-in Python) in this tech world. Many organizations use it at the production level because of its lightness, robustness, and portability. Using at the Production level also requires an efficient backup system in order to prevent data corruption, data loss, and whatnot. As SQLite3 is solely based on a single file, backing up requires the whole file to be copied on each backup (or, snapshot). It requires unnecessary space to save all the snapshots (for a slightly modified version). So, there is the solution, Incremental Backup System. In this system, the database is backed up only when the file content changes, therefore saving much space. I personally browsed over the internet to find any incremental backup system (even unofficial) but a Stackoverflow Thread. So, I wrote myself a lightweight utility/library/module to backup incrementally and save some space while processing a huge amount of database backup.

identity.review: 一个 ER 图（实体关系图）编辑器，支持可视化设计数据库 schema，可从 SQL DDL、GraphQL SDL、DBML、AML 导入，导出多种方言的 DDL 并生成多语言代码。以 PWA、VS Code、IntelliJ、Obsidian 插件及 npm custom element 形式分发，支持端到端加密的 P2P 实时协作（实验性），并通过 MCP server 供编码代理操作。适用于需要绘制和编辑数据库 schema 的开发者。
highlights: 支持 SQL DDL、GraphQL SDL、DBML、AML 四种格式导入，DDL 导出覆盖 Databricks、MariaDB、MSSQL、MySQL、Oracle、PostgreSQL、Snowflake、SQLite
提供 TypeScript、Java、Go 等多语言代码生成，可在浏览器、IDE 插件或 custom element 中嵌入运行
提供基于 WebRTC 的端到端加密 P2P 实时协作，并附带 MCP server 供编码代理编辑图表
use_cases: 可视化设计与评审数据库 schema，绘制实体关系图
从现有 SQL dump 或 DBML 文件导入并生成 ER 图
在 VS Code、IntelliJ、Obsidian 中直接编辑 .erd. 文件或嵌入到自己的页面
